findings: CDMC's exact score record confirms E-flat alto saxophone and piano, Studio Music, London, published 1977, seven pages.
The same title also exists for flugelhorn and brass band. That edition's ISMN9790050030324 must not be transferred to the saxophone score.
Trinity's 2015 saxophone syllabus places Reflections in Grade 4 repertoire. This is an external examination context suggesting pre-college teaching use.
